sloka: यानि मिथ्याभिशस्तानां पतन्त्यस्राणि राघव ।तानि पुत्रपशून् घ्नन्ति प्रीत्यर्थमनुशासत: ॥ २.१००.६०॥
transliteration: yāni mithyābhiśastānāṁ patantyasrāṇi rāghava ।tāni putrapaśūn ghnanti prītyarthamanuśāsata: ॥ 2.100.60॥

translations.english: O Bharata, I trust you wish to thrive by treating the old, children and foremost of learned people with the three expedients namely gifts, affection and kind words.
